This was the main battlefield of
the great war 500 years ago.

rows.label: tlk4532019301_msg0002
rows.name:
The scars of the conflict
back then are still plain
to see in the terrain.

rows.label: tlk4532019301_msg0003
rows.name:
Seeing the crater called Holy Grail
Hammer sent a chill down my spine.
Holy Grail... what terrifying power.
